name: John W. Buster
role: Representative of the Hashknife cattle outfit
bio: John W. Buster represented the Hashknife outfit and was listed at the Northern Pacific hotel as from Texas and from the Hashknife camp. In August, September and October 1885 he oversaw deliveries of about five hundred Hashknife cattle at a time to the company in Medora, with averages from about 1,066 to 1,113 pounds. In October 1886 he passed through Medora on his way to the home ranch at the mouth of Box Elder.
